topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the lecturer's opening welcome and outlines the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate Immune Sensing via Molecular Patterns and Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the innate immune system identifies signs of infection and cellular damage through molecular patterns and dedicated receptor signaling cascades.

topics.label: Effector Mechanisms, Cell Recruitment, and Systemic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how sentinel cells initiate local leukocyte recruitment and lymphatic drainage, as well as the pathological outcomes when acute inflammation escalates systemically.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Containment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the mechanisms responsible for shutting down immune activation, orchestrating tissue healing, and managing unresolved inflammation through chronic containment.

topics.label: Lecture Closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a sign-off and an announcement of the next lecture topic.
